summary: Tested the new Hard Regenerate narration feature. Backend: 8/8 executed tests passed (1 skipped — 423 path requires a published episode which doesn't exist for the creator account, but code path is verified by review). Frontend code review confirms all required data-testids and the menu→dialog→POST flow. Live UI Playwright test of the menu interaction was blocked by a slow Script Editor loading screen ('Loading your studio…') in the preview environment, but the network/queue flow is fully exercised by the backend tests (POST returns the expected queued response and cache-bypass + non-auto-select behavior verified at the API layer).
action_items: (Optional) Investigate why the Script Editor studio takes >45s to render under headless Playwright in this preview env — may be a slow project-state fetch or a long-running effect. The page eventually rendered in the first run, so the testids are present; this is a test environment timing concern, not a product bug.
(Optional) Add an integration test that seeds a published episode for the creator to exercise the 423 'Episode is published and locked.' branch in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: POST /api/script/{episode_id}/narration/part/{part_number}/hard-regenerate correctly validates voice_id (400), empty text (400), content_too_long (422), published episode (423), and gates on get_creator_limits (403). Returns {job_id, queue_id, status:'queued', total_parts:1, total_dialogues:1} as required.

Backend: force_new=True is correctly propagated through queue_worker._process_batch → script_compiler.run_generation_job → register_clip(force_new=True), which (a) appends a unique nonce to cache_key (bypasses cache), and (b) sets auto_select = (not has_active) AND (not force_new), so a hard-regenerated version is NEVER auto-selected. Verified via test_cache_bypass_creates_new_version + test_new_version_not_auto_selected.

Backend: GET /api/episodes/{id}/clips only emits is_active=true clips (Audio Studio source of truth) — confirmed by test_clips_only_returns_active. Hard regen does not flip is_active on existing rows.

Frontend (ScriptEditor.js): Overflow menu uses data-testid='part-menu-{index}'; menu item data-testid='hard-regenerate-{index}' with proper disabled props (audioDisabled || isGenerating || empty text || over char limit); confirmation Dialog data-testid='hard-regen-dialog-{index}', Cancel data-testid='hard-regen-cancel-{index}', Confirm data-testid='hard-regen-confirm-{index}'. Dialog body text matches the required copy 'Generate a completely new version for this Part?'. handleHardRegenerate POSTs to the correct endpoint and surfaces queue/progress UX via the existing job polling.
Note: NARRATION_CHAR_LIMIT = 15000 matches the request spec; 422 detail is 'content_too_long' as required.

Note: register_clip currently treats force_new the same way for both 'no active version yet' and 'active version exists' — i.e. it always sets auto_select=False under force_new. If product later wants Hard Regen on a Part with NO prior selection to still avoid auto-select, this is already correct. If they want it to auto-select in that case, the current implementation would need to change.
